name: Ccoop Group Co., Ltd
summary: Ccoop Group Co., Ltd engages in commercial operations, trade logistics, and commodity trading businesses in China. It is also involved in the businesses of department stores, supermarket chains, civil defense commercial projects, commercial real estate, centralized procurement and distribution centers, and supply chain. The company was formerly known as Xi'an Minsheng Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ccoop Group Co., Ltd in February 2017. Ccoop Group Co., Ltd was founded in 1959 and is based in Xi'an, China.
